paragraphs: Step-by-step
Before you apply for a building permit, follow these steps.
Your property and project plans affect what processes you must follow to get a building permit.

sections.heading: Check if your project needs a permit
paragraphs: Some construction projects do not need a permit.
Check if your project needs a permit

sections.heading: Check and resolve complaints
paragraphs: Check your property’s complaints or notice of violations in our tracking system.
You must resolve notices of violation before you apply for another permit

sections.heading: Check your property’s environmental categories
paragraphs: Your property’s slope, landslide risk, and Maher area will affect your required documents for your project.

sections.heading: Check your property’s historic resource status
paragraphs: If your project will be visible from the street, check your property’s historic status.

sections.heading: Check earthquake safety rules
paragraphs: Check our earthquake safety program for multifamily residential buildings.

sections.heading: Check water use rules
paragraphs: If your project uses water in certain ways, you have to follow additional steps.

sections.heading: Check if your project requires Public Health review
paragraphs: See if your project includes work that requires Public Health approval during plan check.

sections.heading: Check neighborhood development processes
paragraphs: Your project must meet City requirements that keep neighborhoods livable.

sections.heading: Check commercial construction requirements
paragraphs: If your construction project is on a commercial space, check these requirements.
Check commercial construction requirements

sections.heading: Check if your permit needs plans
paragraphs: Most building permit applications require architectural plans drafted by a professional.
Check if your building permit needs plans

sections.heading: Create your plans
paragraphs: If your permit requires plans, follow these rules to create your plans.
Create your plans

sections.heading: Format PDFs of your plans
paragraphs: If you are submitting online, format PDFs of your plans for our electronic plan review software.
Format PDFs of your plans

sections.heading: Get a building permit
paragraphs: You must have a building permit to do construction. Follow these steps.
Most projects can be reviewed over-the-counter. See our instructions to submit a building permit application for over-the-counter review .
For complex projects, follow these steps to get a building permit with In-House Review .
